subject: Re: Kickoff: LEGO multi-hop KGQA on the entity graph
body:
Priya,

Staffing for the window:

- Rafael Duran 50% research lead, owns method adaptation and the accuracy bar.
- Freya Ruiz 30% on query-template design for the entity-graph slice.
- Emeka Pinto 30% infra.

One scoping call I want on record: there's no existing tooling that covers multi-hop QA scoring the way we need it, so we're standing up an internal evaluation harness from scratch — Bilal at 50% through May with Emeka pairing on the runner infrastructure. Per-hop accuracy, latency percentiles, and regression tracking across graph snapshots. It's roughly 40% of our eng budget this quarter but everything downstream depends on trustworthy evals.

Compute: 8 A100s on titan-a100, best-effort is fine.

Deshawn
